subject: MPA onramp: security snapshot & next steps
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: security@nimbank.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MPA onramp: security snapshot & next steps

Hi Olivia / Nimble security team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As promised, I attached a short mutual action plan (MPA) draft and a completed SIG/CAIQ worksheet we use to accelerate evaluations. The goal here is to surface the security gates and assign owners so we can fast-track evaluation and close. High-level asks from your side: SOC 2 Type II report access, signed DPA (we can accept redlines), and confirmation of data residency needs. From our side: audit artifacts, SOC 2 evidence collection plan, and an escrow/archival proposal for long-term retention.

Key milestones I propose in the MPA (attached: mpa_draft_v1.pdf):
- Week 0 (today -> 2027-09-22): Finalize MAP owners & sign-off on scope (SOC2, SIG, DPA, retention tiers)
- Week 1 (by 2027-09-29): Provide SOC 2 summary and CAIQ responses; Nimble to provide DPA primary redlines
- Week 2 (by 2027-10-06): Evidence intake kickoff; tech workshop on residency/KMS options
- Week 4 (by 2027-10-20): Acceptance checkpoint (mutual confirmation that security gates satisfied)

Open questions for Nimble:
1) Do you require EU or APAC data residency, or is US region sufficient for the pilot?
2) Will you need HSM-backed customer key separation for long-term retention?

Attachments: mpa_draft_v1.pdf, sig_questionnaire.xlsx (initial CAIQ).

If the timeline aligns, can we book a 45-minute evidence intake workshop next Tue (2027-09-22) at 09:00 PT? I can have Neha join to cover SOC 2 and evidence pathways.

Thanks —
Ethan Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0135

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@nimbank.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbank.com, security@nimbank.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MPA onramp: security snapshot & next steps

Ethan —

Appreciate the clear MAP. I attached our DPA redlines (nimbank_dpa_redlines.docx) and a compliance calendar so you can see our internal procurement cutover. A few quick clarifications from our security team:

- Residency: Pilot must remain in the US (no EU/APAC). Production will likely need EU for EU customers, but not required for this evaluation.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for any PII persistence. HSM-backed KMS preferred; please indicate options.
- Evidence access: We can accept SOC 2 Type II summary + sampled artifacts. We typically require at least 6 months of trace logs for ingestion testing.

On the timeline: our procurement lead has a hard budget approval date of 2027-10-18. If we can complete the acceptance checkpoint by 2027-10-20 as you propose, procurement will prioritize the commitment.

Can you confirm who on your side will be the engineering contact for the KMS discussion? Also — we prefer the intake workshop on Tue 2027-09-22 at 13:00 ET.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Security & Compliance
NimbleBank
olivia.barnes@nimbank.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@nimbank.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA onramp: security snapshot & next steps

Olivia / team —

Thanks for the redlines and the calendar. Quick answers and commitments from our side to make the intake efficient:

1) Residency: US-only pilot is fine. For production EU residency we can provision a dedicated private deployment in the eu-west-1 region; that would be a separate procurement line-item and timeline.

2) KMS/keys: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations with HSM-backed providers. Options: (a) Redwood-managed envelope encryption with customer KMS separation, (b) BYOK via partner HSM (customer retains full key custody). We'll cover both options in the tech workshop.

3) SOC 2 evidence: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary today and scoped artifacts via a secured intake link. Full evidence package (redacted) available within 5 business days of workshop. Link: https://redwood-inference.com/soc2/2027-type2 (summary). Attached: soc2_summary.pdf.

4) Retention & logs: We can expose 6 months of ingestion logs for the acceptance test and provide an archival SLA for 7+ years if required. We'll map retention tiers in the MPA appendix.

Action items I will take on:
- Upload evidence intake playbook and grant Nimble read-only access to the artifact folder by end of day 2027-09-17.
- Run the KMS options doc during the Tuesday tech workshop (2027-09-22 12:00 PT / 13:00 ET).
- Update MPA with clear owners and the procurement milestone aligned to 2027-10-18 budget approval.

Next steps: I will revise the MPA and SIG responses after the workshop. Please confirm final attendee list for Tuesday (engineering contact and procurement rep).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@nimbank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA onramp: security snapshot & next steps

Olivia / team —

Quick note from my side: I reviewed the updated timeline and priorities — we will prioritize the DPA legal review and SOC 2 evidence intake to hit Nimble's procurement deadline. I've looped Legal (shared separately) on the DPA redlines and asked for a turnaround by 2027-10-05.

If the tech workshop uncovers anything blocking (KMS, residency), escalate to me and I'll coordinate capacity with our product infra team. Looking forward to the intake on Tue.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, GTM & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
